newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt inflation down to 5.7 pct at end Nov.
newsitem.headline: Egypt inflation down to 5.7 pct at end Nov.

text.p: Egyptian inflation fell to 5.7 percent in the year to the end of November, from 7.0 percent at the end of October, the cabinet office said on Wednesday.
The rate, based on the consumer price index for urban areas, was the lowest in 1996. But it was higher than at end-November 1995, when it stood at 4.9 percent, the lowest for many decades.
A cabinet office spokeswoman said the price index rose 0.3 percent during the month of November.
